summary.text: Russ Diamond, listed as Russell Diamond by Ballotpedia, is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House District 102 who has served since December 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A Lebanon County business owner, he was a government reform advocate before entering office.

paragraphs.text: Russell Diamond was born in Hershey, Pennsylvania, and his career experience includes working as a business owner.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign said he graduated from Northern Lebanon High School and Lebanon County Vo-Tech in 1981 and opened a recording studio in Lebanon in 1992 that grew into a CD manufacturing and duplicating service.
It also said that before holding office he was a government reform advocate who led opposition to the 2005 legislative pay raise.
Diamond assumed office in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives on December 1, 2014.

He was one of nine candidates in the Republican primary for Pennsylvania lieutenant governor on May 17, 2022, finishing seventh with 6.0% of the vote, and he won re-election to the House that November.
In the 2023-2024 session, he chaired the Gaming Oversight Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
